routes.summary: Run due scheduled deletion requests through the controlled background purge workflow.

authorization.predicate: Active tenant membership plus jobs.manage; only due scheduled requests inside tenant scope are processed.

idempotency.rule: Not replayable without a fresh state read; clients receive 409 when the expected state changed.

concurrency.rule: Executor claims SCHEDULED rows by conditional update to RUNNING before purge, blocks active legal holds, redacts active content while preserving accountability records, and completes RUNNING rows atomically.

audit.rule: Each completed purge writes DELETION_COMPLETED with purge-policy and backup-limitation metadata.

routes.summary: List active or historical legal holds.

authorization.predicate: Active tenant membership plus retention.read; holds loaded by company_id only.

idempotency.rule: No Idempotency-Key accepted; service checks tenant-scoped state before mutation.

concurrency.rule: Service loads target in company scope, validates current status/legal hold state, and writes audit events in the same transaction where feasible.

routes.summary: Place a company-wide or entity-specific legal hold that blocks purge.

authorization.predicate: OWNER or ADMIN with retention.manage; optional target entity loaded in tenant scope.

idempotency.rule: No Idempotency-Key accepted; service checks tenant-scoped state before mutation.

concurrency.rule: Service loads target in company scope, validates current status/legal hold state, and writes audit events in the same transaction where feasible.

audit.rule: Important retention/deletion/legal-hold mutation writes an audit event; reads write no event.

routes.summary: Release an active legal hold.

authorization.predicate: OWNER or ADMIN with retention.manage; legal hold loaded in tenant scope.

idempotency.rule: Idempotency-Key or replay-safe state check returns the existing committed result within tenant scope; conflicting in-flight state returns 409.
idempotency.scope: tenant + method + path + authenticated actor + Idempotency-Key

concurrency.rule: conditional update requires released_at to remain null; replay of already released hold is safe.

audit.rule: Important retention/deletion/legal-hold mutation writes an audit event; reads write no event.

routes.summary: Create a same-family framework upgrade reconciliation draft and preview stable-code matches.

authorization.predicate: OWNER, ADMIN, or COMPLIANCE_MANAGER in active tenant; old enrollment must be ACTIVE and scoped to tenant.

idempotency.rule: No Idempotency-Key support in Pass 24; duplicate open draft for same company/framework family returns 409.

concurrency.rule: Creates DRAFT_RECONCILIATION only when old enrollment is ACTIVE and no draft exists for the same company/framework family.

routes.summary: Read a framework upgrade reconciliation preview and candidate mappings.

authorization.predicate: OWNER, ADMIN, or COMPLIANCE_MANAGER in active tenant; draft enrollment must belong to selected tenant.

idempotency.rule: Read-only endpoint; clients may safely retry.

concurrency.rule: Reads reconciliation state current at request time; activation uses separate transactional preconditions.

routes.summary: Atomically activate a reviewed framework upgrade and end the prior same-family enrollment.

authorization.predicate: OWNER, ADMIN, or COMPLIANCE_MANAGER in active tenant; reconciliation must be OPEN/REVIEWED and draft enrollment must be DRAFT_RECONCILIATION.

idempotency.rule: Not replayable without a fresh state read; clients receive 409 when the expected state changed.

concurrency.rule: single transaction conditionally ENDS old ACTIVE enrollment, ACTIVATES DRAFT_RECONCILIATION enrollment, copies mappings only once, and marks reconciliation ACTIVATED once.

routes.summary: List time-bounded auditor access grants using the canonical v2.1 route.

authorization.predicate: Active tenant membership plus auditor_grants.manage; grants are scoped by company_id.

idempotency.rule: Read-only route; no idempotency key accepted.

concurrency.rule: Only current active tenant grants or selected auditor-visible resources are returned.

routes.summary: Create a bounded read-only auditor grant using the canonical v2.1 route.

authorization.predicate: OWNER, ADMIN, or COMPLIANCE_MANAGER with auditor_grants.manage; auditor member and scope loaded inside tenant scope.

idempotency.rule: Duplicate active grant for company + auditor member + scope is rejected with 409.

concurrency.strategy: database unique partial index plus service preconditions
concurrency.rule: Active duplicate grant is blocked; scope and auditor membership are validated inside tenant scope before create.

routes.summary: Revoke a time-bounded auditor grant immediately using the canonical v2.1 route.

authorization.predicate: Active tenant membership plus auditor_grants.manage; grant loaded inside tenant scope.

idempotency.rule: Replay-safe revoke returns the existing revoked result within tenant scope; conflicting in-flight state returns 409.
idempotency.scope: tenant + method + path + authenticated actor + Idempotency-Key

concurrency.rule: conditional update requires revoked_at to remain null; replay of already revoked grant is safe.

routes.summary: List only controls selected by active time-bounded auditor grants.

authorization.predicate: AUDITOR role plus active unexpired unrevoked grant covering framework/control/evidence-derived controls.

idempotency.rule: Read-only route; no idempotency key accepted.

concurrency.rule: Only current active tenant grants or selected auditor-visible resources are returned.

routes.summary: List only approved evidence selected by active time-bounded auditor grants.

authorization.predicate: AUDITOR role plus active unexpired unrevoked grant; only approved/current-approved evidence and approved mappings are returned; downloads additionally require download_allowed=true.

idempotency.rule: Read-only route; no idempotency key accepted.

concurrency.rule: Only current active tenant grants or selected auditor-visible resources are returned.

routes.summary: List only completed reports selected by active time-bounded auditor grants.

authorization.predicate: AUDITOR role plus active unexpired unrevoked grant; only completed reports are returned; downloads additionally require download_allowed=true.

idempotency.rule: Read-only route; no idempotency key accepted.

concurrency.rule: Only current active tenant grants or selected auditor-visible resources are returned.

routes.summary: List current user notification preferences and mandatory notification types.

authorization.predicate: Active tenant membership plus notifications.read; preferences are scoped to the current user and tenant only.

idempotency.rule: Read-only preference listing; clients may retry.

concurrency.rule: Read-only preference listing.

routes.summary: Update current user notification preferences for non-security categories.

authorization.predicate: Active tenant membership plus notifications.read; mandatory account/security and invitation notifications cannot be disabled.

idempotency.rule: Preference writes are last-write-wins within tenant/user scope; clients may retry after reading current preferences.

concurrency.rule: Service rejects attempts to disable mandatory notification categories.
